It stays at its floor on ordinary words whatever their tokenization (continuation pieces deeper inside a word, and common morphemes such as 'ing', 'ed', 's', 'tion', are 1.2-3.3% active and single-token words 1.7%, against a 2.7% scan base rate), on detached punctuation (comma 2.2%, brackets 1.6%, newline 1.2%, sentence-final period 2.9%, against 14% for a hyphen and 66% for the period after a single capital), on digit-bearing units (0.6%) and on non-Latin scripts (Arabic 0%, Chinese 0.03%, Korean 0.2%).
